endcard: Save this. Keep one small deed.

save.ar:
أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
save.tr: “The acts most pleasing to Allah are those which are done continuously, even if they are small.”

lines.say: The deed Allah loves most isn't the biggest one.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, was asked which deeds Allah loves most.
lines.cap: The Prophet ﷺ was asked which deeds Allah loves most

lines.say: He said: the most constant ones, even if they are small.
lines.cap: “The most constant ones, even if they are small”

lines.say: And he said: take on only the deeds you are able to do.
lines.cap: “Take on only the deeds you are able to do”

lines.say: And whenever Aishah began a good deed, she kept on doing it.
lines.cap: Whenever Aishah began a deed, she kept on doing it

lines.say: So don't wait to do something big. Pick one small deed, and don't let it go.
lines.cap: Don't wait for something big. Pick one small deed, and don't let it go.

lines.say: Save this, and send it to someone who wants to start again.
lines.cap: Save this & send it to someone starting again 🤍

h1.ar:
أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
h1.tr: “The acts most pleasing to Allah are those which are done continuously, even if they are small.”

h2.tr: “Don't take upon yourselves, except the deeds which are within your ability.”
